name: @jangmanj/pi-speech
description: Text-to-speech and speech-to-text for Pi: read replies aloud, dictate prompts (Alt+Z), transcribe audio. OpenRouter, xAI, OpenAI-compatible endpoints or local on-device models (Whisper, Parakeet, Kokoro), with playback on a remote machine over SSH
